messages.subject: Remove border from legend items
parts:
Hi,

I switched to theme_bw() and now the items in the legend have a grey
border. I don't know why. If i switch back to theme_grey() the legend
has no border. the legend items have no border.
there does not seem to be an option to change that either -- though i
might not have the complete option list.
http://yfrog.com/0clegendtj (link to image shack)

Anybody knows why?

Thank you in advance,
Thomas

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Re: Remove border from legend items
parts:
ok, nevermind, I had a typo.
solution:
opts(legend.key = theme_blank())
